correctness.rationale: Equation (2.3) gives the index ratio; the reciprocal cubic factorization maps each of five coordinates to an exact nonnegative pair. Irreducibility modulo 11 plus cubic irreducibility over Q(sqrt 2) rules out torsion of u/conj(u), proving that exactly equal exponent pairs yield equal candidate sites. Their generating function is the product of five geometric series. Setting \(x=y=t\) and expanding the order-five pole at \(t=1\) proves the all-h asymptotic; independently replayed finite code verifies the algebraic certificate and integer coefficients through h=45. Candidate sites are not conflated with actual poles.
